Revision 143 | Coordinator: /root | Latest complete matrix remains v218: 1/32 cells and 399/432 checks passed. The next full matrix remains unstarted. G6-054 stays parked.
V219-PUBLIC-EPOCH-WITNESS — Owner: media_blockers; supplemental controls: v198_resources; independent reviewer: fixture_blockers; coordinator: Root. The main profile2 batch is applied and independently verified: all 130 targeted checks passed (46 Python, 84 Node), formatting passed, and all original test processes joined with source unchanged. This includes 18 directly affected controls, six new packet-index cases and 112 retained or adjacent checks. Rust and SDK code remain unchanged in this batch.
The witness now records exact public ownership intervals with separate send and receive stream IDs, collects every alias within the bounded census, and requires a passive wire control even when no marker repeats. Indexed epoch ranges retain complete source/target packet and frame checks. Review found and fixed a source-only whole-frame loss hole and an incorrect use of receive IDs for replacement senders. Private, wrong-owner, wrong-track, repeated original-source timestamps, missing packets and unknown evidence still fail. Raw media quality limits are unchanged.
The targeted controls cover 66 aliases across three synthetic closed cycles, zero-alias control, replacement ownership/direction boundaries, sequence wrap and reordering, two-fragment frames, duplicates, memory limits and the original final deadline. These are unit/control results, not a new real media programme or matrix result. Original mapping exports and prior failed runs remain unchanged.
V219-RETIREMENT-BINDING — Owner: media_blockers; native metadata contributor: v198_resources; independent reviewer: fixture_blockers; coordinator: Root. A real fixture coverage gap remains: in the last focused run the old peer's final native RTP sample preceded the public cut by 376–556 ms. A wholly public frame pair in that tail can lack a later sample. The main batch correctly refuses that unknown case and includes a regression control. Readiness is still false.
Root tested the pinned Firefox APIs before choosing a fix. A getStats request interrupted by immediate close did not complete; a fresh request after close returned no RTP rows. Those approaches are ruled out. A warm native probe confirmed synchronous receiver SSRC/RTP-coordinate observations, selected ICE endpoints and sender SSRC declarations are available before close. The proposed separate terminal-binding record must use the same original peer, native sender/receiver and transceiver identity, without delaying close or fabricating a later statistics sample. It remains under design review. The native source timestamp and monotonic page clock stay separate; SDP MSID is not assumed equal to a JS track ID.
Earlier focused449 remains failed: audio6/6, A/V6/6, single-cycle resource passed; raw video0/6 had 22 unresolved draw aliases. Its ten complete mapping exports across14 epochs verify the repaired ownership cycles. The numeric Firefox private-profile fix also remains verified by six checks and actual native preference behavior. Neither result promotes a matrix cell.
Next: complete and unit-test the bounded retirement binding, then run the prepared normal three-cycle focused Firefox programme with actual native stats/Core/closed-wire evidence. After it passes, execute the complete current regression, local ARM source preparation/tests, normal releases and final preflight before reporting ready for32. Keep the full matrix on hold during this preparation phase.
